description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 05 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of an appropriation statute (Statute No. 05 of 2017) for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It involves legal modifications to financial regulations and advance account limits, which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and legislative amendments.
